sources.name: Node.js os.availableParallelism
sources.summary: Official Node.js OS API for recommended parallelism metadata; Phase 44E buckets the value and does not benchmark.

sources.name: Node.js os.totalmem
sources.summary: Official Node.js OS API for total memory in bytes; Phase 44E stores only coarse buckets.

sources.name: Node.js os.freemem
sources.summary: Official Node.js OS API for free memory in bytes; Phase 44E stores only coarse buckets.

sources.name: Node.js os.arch
sources.summary: Official Node.js OS API for compiled architecture; Phase 44E stores architecture buckets only.

sources.name: Node.js os.machine
sources.summary: Official Node.js OS API for machine type; Phase 44E treats this as future optional coarse evidence only.

sources.name: Node.js os.cpus caution
sources.summary: Official Node.js docs caution against using os.cpus().length for parallelism; Phase 44E avoids exact CPU model persistence.

sources.name: Electron process API
sources.summary: Official Electron process metadata source for future coarse Electron context detection; Phase 44E does not require Electron.

sources.name: Electron process sandboxing
sources.summary: Official Electron sandboxing guidance; Phase 44E treats sandboxed renderers as requiring a future main-process bridge.
